domain_overview: JGH Intelligence Engine manages supply chain tracking, mechanics & retailer loyalty rewards, wholesaler inventory dispatches, and financial ledger payouts.

user_roles.1: Admin - System administrator with overall platform oversight
user_roles.2: Retailer / Mechanic - End-user mechanics and retail shop owners earning points via QR box scans
user_roles.3: Distributor - Primary product distributors and stocking partners
user_roles.4: Sales Officer - Regional field sales representatives monitoring retailer signups
user_roles.5: Wholesaler - Regional stock wholesalers scanning boxes prior to retailer dispatch
user_roles.7: Area Manager - Regional sales and operations managers
user_roles.10: Warehouse Manager - Primary logistics and Kolkata inventory dispatch head
user_roles.13: Accounts Head - Financial controller managing withdrawal approvals and bank payouts
user_roles.14: System Service - Automated background worker service account

reference_types.cash_point: Points earned directly via physical QR code box scans by mechanics/retailers
reference_types.topup: Direct wallet top-up credits added via payment gateway or manual admin credit
reference_types.withdrawal: Funds debited from wallet upon user payout request approval
reference_types.incentive: Performance-based bonus incentives awarded for achieving quarterly scan targets
reference_types.bonus_conversion: Points converted from promotional rewards programs into wallet cash balance
reference_types.referral_earning: Bonus credits earned for onboarding new mechanics or retailers
reference_types.credit_note: Adjustments credited by accounting for returned or damaged inventory

inventory_tracking.dual_scan_mechanics: Each box scan updates status_retailer_id (Retailer scan) or status_wholeseller_id (Wholesaler scan). Both fields reference users.id.
inventory_tracking.points_mapping: sku_inventories.sku_code links to sku_qr_points_maps.sku_code to calculate retailer_cash_points and wholeseller_cash_points.
